correctness.rationale: TARGET vanishing-branch proof audited: the explicit Redei norm identity a^2-(1+zeta)b^2=pi3*z^2 with a=-(1+zeta+zeta^2), b=-(1+zeta-zeta^3), z=zeta^3+zeta^2-1 was re-verified by independent exact integer arithmetic in Z[t]/(t^4+1) (N=[-5,-3,1,4]=pi3a*z^2, confirmed equal), and absolute norms N(z)=1, N(pi2)=2, N(pi3)=9, N(piq)=17 confirm the prime factorizations. The Hilbert-grid method for pairwise cup vanishing is sound: K=Q(zeta_8) is totally complex and the three uniformizers are supported only above 2, 3, 17, so checking the 9 listed finite places (plus extra place above 5) covers all places where symbols can be nontrivial. An independent mod-17 residue-field check corroborates the headline [2,2] splitting: t^4+1 has roots {2,8,9,15} mod 17 with q at t=8; K1 model m1(y) has roots {3,4,13,14} with the two lifts of t=8 at y=3,14 where A(y)=8,16 are both nonzero quadratic residues mod 17, i.e. x^2-A splits unramified with e=f=1 at both K1-primes above q. Class numbers, irreducibility of x^2-A over K1, and discriminant support are reproducible PARI computations honestly labeled as such with script plus log; the D8 closure uses the standard Redei norm-relation lemma (no polgalois claimed). A second independent defining system giving the same splitting guards against defining-system artifacts.
